features.feature: Rehab estimator with 500+ item cost database and SOW
features.quote: Start from a pre-built cost database of over 500 common repair items and unit prices, customize it to your market, and generate a detailed estimate and professional scope of work in minutes.

features.feature: Pre-written SOW notes shared with contractors
features.quote: Pre-written SOW Notes for each repair category telling the contractor exactly wat to include in their proposal.

features.feature: Comps tool with pick / drop and live ARV
features.quote: It automatically pulls a list of recent comparable sales that match your subject property, lets you pick the best comps and drop the bad ones, and calculates the average price per square foot

features.feature: Thumbs up / thumbs down comp selection
features.quote: Thumb down a comp to flag it. It drops to the bottom of the list, gets highlighted in red so it's easy to spot, and disappears from the map view

features.feature: Change orders tracked against contingency in Expense Tracker
features.quote: You can now track this amount separately as a Change Order using the 'Adders' option on the drop down menu. Expenses tracked as Change Orders will are then deducted from your Adders/Contingency budget
Take a photo of any receipt, and AI automatically extracts the vendor, date, amount, and category

features.feature: AI bulk expense importer (Home Depot Pro Xtra, bank statement PDF/CSV)
features.quote: You can now drop in raw, unstructured CSVs or even PDF bank statements.
Track expenses, compare budget vs. actuals, and control project finances.

features.feature: Share individual project update with lenders / partners
features.quote: Generate a share link for any individual project update so you can send a specific progress report to your lenders or partners without sharing your entire update log.
